tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang gi cho ga byin rlabs kyi chab rgyun ces bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdul tshon sogs bri 'phreng ba bzhin// ras bris yid kyi dkyil 'khor tshe// bum pa slob ma'i sta gon dang*// dkyil 'khor bsgrub dang slob dpon 'jug /slob ma dbang bskur rjes kyi las// dang po ni/ 'phreng ba nyid du/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ram ras bris la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ram mngon sum du byas pa'i yid kyi rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor du ji ltar gsungs pa'i mchod pa la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas slob ma rab tu gnas pa dang*/ sku gzugs la sogs pa rab tu gnas pa yang bya'o// de la dkyil 'khor gzhan du sngar gsungs pa'i cho gas dang*/ bum pa lhag par gnas par byas nas zhes pa la sogs pas rdul tshon las gzhan ras bris la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la sa dang lha'i lhag gnas mi dgos par bum pa dang slob ma sku gzugs sta gon tsam gsungs pa bzhin/ zhi rgyas la bsngags pa'i bum pa gnyis chus bkrus kha dog bsgyur/ mgul chings dang kha brgyan/ rnam rgyal du dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo dang*/ las thams cad par las thams cad pa'i mtshan ma dri bzang gis bri/ bum rdzas nyer lnga btab pa'i chu srog chags med pa gtsang mas bkang*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ to da ka ṭha hūm̐ dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun bzlas pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin dang ldan par mos pa'i dri dang bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i dung chos sam/ padma'i snod me tog gi 'phreng ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje nang du bzhag pa rnam rgyal gyi steng du bkod/ oṃ tapte tapte ma hā tapte swā hā/ zhes lha'i chu bo spyan drangs ba la dang*/ mtshan ma rnams bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa'i bar zhes dkyil 'khor so so la 'don pa bsgyur bar bya'o// rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa lta bu'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mdun du spyan drangs pa la/

phyag rgyar bcas pas/ oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra satka ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ arghaṃ gyi tshab tu pā dyaṃ dang*/ prokṣa ṇāṃ dang*/ añtsa mā nāṃ brjod pas zhabs bsil dang bsang gtor dang*/ zhal bsil phul nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par thim zhing lha tshogs de dag chags pa chen pos khu bar zhu bar gyur pa byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ de nas rdo rje dang 'brel ba'i me tog gi 'phreng ba g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis hūm̐ brjod de bzung nas 'khor lo'i bdag po'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o// oṃ badzra u da ka hūm̐ bsngags pa'i chu// oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ bzlas pa'i me tog gsum gzhug par bya'o// de bzhin las thams cad pa la yang gzhan 'gre la/ lha mi bzhu bar sku las bdud rtsi babs pa bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu bsam/ de nyid kyi kha rgyan gyis bsang gtor byas la/ lha de 'dir ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs pa de srid du bgegs rnams zlog par mdzod cig ces brjod cing*/ a kā ros gtor ma phul nas nye reg byas te/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod do/ slob ma sta gon ni/ bsam pa dbang dang gsol gdab dang*/ spro bskyed sdom gnyis srung ba dang*// byin brlab mchod dang so shing chu// ku sha bsrung skud chos bshad pa// bsrung dang rmi lam brtag rnams so// slob ma gcig gam gnyis sam mang po rnams khrus byas maṇḍal phul te 'dug pa la/ gsang sngags dngos grub don gnyer gang*// bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan// 'jig rten pha rol la gzhol ba// kha cig dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug byed// 'jig rten gzhan don 'dod pa yi// blo bzang dad pa cher byas 'jug /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras spangs nas// 'jig rten gzhan don la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// 'di las 'jig rten gzhan gyi min// de phyir 'jig rten gzhan dag gi

/dngos grub don du yid brtan gyis// zhes gdams/ rang 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug zhal nas zhugs/ zhu bar gyur pa'i khu ba rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi padmar 'thon/ gtso bo'i gzugs su gyur pa la slar snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yum dang bcas spyan drangs/ kha nas zhugs/ 'od du zhu ba'i rgyun gyis de dag la mngon par dbang bskur nas phyir 'thon te shar sgor gnas par gyur pas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ skye rga na 'chi na bkra ba'i/ chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba// srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen por bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab// slob ma gcig gtso bor byas nas// bu tshur shog cig theg chen gyi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa// da ltar bzhugs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des// skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug bcas nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces spro ba bskyed/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// lan gsum gyis thun mong gi sdom pa byin// slob dpon gyi sdom pa gzung ba'i phyir/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur mchog /stsal nas mgon po bdag cag ni// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang*// sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig gi /sdom pa gsang ba bla na med// rtag tu sems can kun don phyir// slob dpon du 'gyur bdag la gsungs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'debs so// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni gzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te mchog tu gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyi zhing*// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// lan gsum gyis khas blangs// oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsrungs// rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis snying mgrin dpral bar reg cing hūm̐ aḥ.oṃ/

zhes brjod pas/ snying gar nyi ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje nag po hūm̐/ mgrin par nyi ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i padma dmar po āḥspyi bor nyi ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs de dag tu rim pa bzhin thim par mos pas oṃ āḥhūm̐// zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha hūm̐ mgor/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gnyis mdun du/ gandhe/ snying gar phul te/ so shing rgyu rung ba sor bcu gnyis pa drang zhing srog chags med pa ma gas pa/ rma med pa/ dri bzang gi chus bkrus pa rtse mor me tog bcings pa byang du phyogs te sbyin/ de rnams kyis khru bzhi pa'i gru bzhi pa ba byung gis byugs pa'i dkyil 'khor la shar ram byang du phyogs pas/ oṃ badzra hā sa haṃ/ rtse mo steng du lta ba bltos pa med par dor bas/ shar byang nub lhor so shing gi rtse bstan na zhi rgyas dbang drag steng 'og mkha' spyod dang sa 'og gi rig 'dzin/ phyir lhung na dngos grub med/ baṃ yig las bdud rtsi'i chu// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa lan bdun bzlas la 'dis sbyin par bya'o// oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha sarba dharmāḥsarba pā pā ni tsa sya ya sarbā bi kalpān a ba nā ya hūm̐ zhes khyor bar lan gsum 'thung zhing lhag ma rgyab tu dor ro// de nas hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha la 'khyil pa bzlas nas rtse mo ma nyams pa stan phyir dang dhīḥyi ge las byung ba la 'khyil pa bzlas pa sngas kyi don du// oṃ badzra tikṣā baṃ gyis byin no// de nas skud dmar lus kyi tshad gsum du bsdebs pa hūm̐ las bskyed pa/ 'khyil pa bzlas/ mdud pa gsum mam drug byas te dpung ba g.yas g.yon la bcings/ oṃ buddha mai tri rakṣa rakṣa sarba na swā hā/ rdo rje rgya gram gyi rnam pas bsrung bar bya'o// de nas chos bshad par bya ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag

/u dumba ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang yang mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur lags na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags brjod pa'i// tshul la gnas ni smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na// de dag kun gyi ngan 'gro'i rgyun// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su gzung ste skye bzhin pa// de ltar khyed rnams theg chen la// legs par skye ba nyid du 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong ba na// rang byung skal ba chen po pa// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// de nas 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsrung*// nang par bdag la rmi lam rjod cig ces smras te// dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs dang nye bar seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal// rang nyid de dag bsrung ba'i don du 'khyil pa bzla'o// slob ma sta gon no// de nas phyi nyin ras bris sam tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor legs par bkod// mtha' ma mchod pas brgyan/ dbang rdzas bshams/ bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa byas te rnal 'byor gyi yo byad tshang bas/ shar gyi sgo nas nub tu gdong phyogs pas bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ 'khyil pa bzlas pa'i chus dkyil 'khor bsangs/ yi ge gsum dang 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod pas yang dag par bsrungs nas mngon rtogs ji lta bar/

mdun kyi dkyil 'khor dang bdag nyid gnyis ka skad cig gis stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs pa nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur zhes pa'i bar gyis dkyil 'khor so so bsgom/ de nas las rgya yod na'am med na bdag dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya snyoms par 'jug pa dang yang dag par bskyod pa shin tu dga' ba'i sgras bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ bum bskyed bzhin chu bzhi phul nas rang gi zhal du zhugs 'dod chags chen por zhu ba slar yang rdo rje'i lam nas padmar phyung ba ye shes kyi lha'i 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can du gyur pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spros pa mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa so so la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ lha mo rkyang pa rnams la/ bdag nyid lha mor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i nas zhu ba gsang ba'i khar ye shes kyi lha'i 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can du gyur pa man 'dra'o// dkyil 'khor de dag gi lus ngag yid sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang skye mched rnams sems dpa'i rang bzhin/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa dang rig pa'i lha mo rnams spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin dag pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas dbang bskur/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ rigs ma nges pa rnams la mi bskyod pa'am rdor sems kyis rgyas btab bo// snying ga'i sa bon las spros pa dang 'dod snam gyi lha mo rnams kyis yid kyi rang bzhin las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod par mos te/ dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul// phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa'i// mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kun// rnam pa kun tu mchod par 'bul// zhes bsdus pa'am/

rgyas par spro na/ lha yi gos ni sna tshogs dang*// bla re yol ba dar dpyangs mda'// gser sogs rin chen gter gyi bum// glang po rta sogs bzhon pa dang*// na chung yid 'ong thams cad dang*// bdag nyid dngos po kun gyis ni// dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul bar bgyi// bza' dang bca' ba yang dag nyid// kha dog dri dang ro ldan dang*// lhan skyes sbyar dang yongs gyur pa'i// rnam pa mang po'i btung bas mchod// lha mo zla ba ltar dkar gzugs// mtshar sdug lang tshos snyems pa'i gar// me tog 'phreng bas sgrib zol gyis// mtho ris 'dun sa bzhin du mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lha mo gnam kha ltar mthing gzugs// dri zhim ngad pa 'thul ba'i gar// bdug spos 'phreng bas= dhū pe/ lha mo mtshams sprin ltar dmar gzugs/ nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od 'phro'i gar/ mar me'i 'phreng bas= ā lo ke lha mo margata ltar ljang gzugs/ reg pas sim byed byug pa'i gar/ dri chab 'phreng bas= gandhe/ lha mo gser ltar ser ba'i gzugs/ ma mchu'i ro brgya dngar ba'i gar/ zhal zas 'phreng bas= nai widyā/ lha mo baiḍūr ltar sngo'i gzugs/ snyan 'gyur glu sgra sgrog pa'i gar/ rol mo'i 'phreng bas= shabda/ nyer mchod/ pi wang ma dang gling bu ma/ rdza rnga ma dang rnga chen ma// bzhad ma sgeg mo glu gar ma// me tog ma dang spos chags ma// mar me ma dang dri chab ma// me long ma dang ro 'dzin ma// reg bya ma dang chos ldan ma// nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par bgyi// mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje dbyings khyod phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che// rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston mdzad rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal// rin chen rgyal po shin tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med// rdo rje'i sku khyod phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che// rdo rje nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// sa dang pha rol phyin pa brnyes// rdo rje gsung khyod phyag 'tshal lo// don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs can// dag pa'i ngo bo nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/

rang shes rab dang sbyar ba'i me tog dang bcas pa'i byang chub sems padma'i snod du bcug pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥbadud rtsir byas pa/ oṃ badzra amṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ bde ba chen po'i dam tshig tu lhag par mos pas 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o// sngar bzhin bum pa bsgrub/ de nas thabs dang shes rab sems ma g.yos pas bsams pa tsam gyis dkyil 'khor dbang po la sogs pa gtor mgron rnams spyan drangs/ thabs dang shes rab tshul de nyid kyis/ oṃ yig gis sbyangs/ āḥyig gis mang por spel/ hūm̐ yig gis kha dog dri ro bcud phun sum tshogs par spar/ hoḥyig gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bzhu ba'i gtor ma/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā dya nutpanna totta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ rang gi 'dod pa'i lha nas 'byung po'i bar thams cad la gtor ma phul ci 'dod pa'i 'phrin las bcol te/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg grub na bya/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal pa'i nga rgyal gyis me tog gi 'phreng ba blangs te/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛ hṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛ shṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rdo rje'i shugs kyis dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol/ rdo rje'i rkang stabs kyis bskor ba byed ngag tu oṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥphaṭ/ oṃ āḥ.ā ཿāḥphaṭ oṃ hūm̐ ha na mā ra ya sarba duṣḍān ghā ta ya ghā ta ya aḥ.aḥhūṃ hrīḥphaṭ/ ces pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum bya/ oṃ badzra udgha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis sgo phye bar bsam/ de bzhin byang du gnas pa nas lho la sogs pa'i sgo dbye'o// lhag pa dang chad pa'i nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir 'khor lo la bltas nas me tog gi 'phreng ba/

oṃ par ma su khā sha ya/ su la lī ta// bi lā si na mi tair na mā mi bha ga wāntaṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥhi hi hi hi hrīḥ pra tītstsha ku su māñdza liṃ nā tha hos/ bcom ldan 'das ma la phul te slar mgo bor bcing*/ g.yas skor du nub tu gnas pas dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'o// de nas 'khor lo'i dbang phyug bla mar mos pa la 'chad par 'gyur pa bzhin gyi dbang rdzogs par blangs nas/ slob dpon gyi las thams cad la rjes su gnang ba thos nas slob ma gzhug pa'i don du/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma mtha' ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa'i rdo rje che rang bzhin// rdo rje 'dzin par bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs shig /nyes pa med pa rtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba ste// bcom ldan de nyid bdag sgrubs shig /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdong nas dag pa de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems su bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po mchog gi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal bas rgyal// grub pa'i rdo rje cher gsal ba// rdo rje snyems par bdag sgrubs shig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ sems can kun gyi yab nyid de// 'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /de nas bden pa bsgrag par bya ste// shes rab thabs dag dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa// mgon po khyod kyi bden pa des// bdag gi 'dod pa skong gyur cig /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las la kun tu byung*// de bzhin kho na nyid las skyes// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog

/slob dpon 'jug pa'o// dbang bskur ba la rnam pa gnyis// 'jug dang dbang bskur rnam gnyis so// slob ma lhag par gnas par byas pa rnams khrus byas/ dri bzang dang ldan zhing 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod pa/ yol ba'i phyir slob ma rang rang gi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gam rnam snang du dmigs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nutta ra bo dhi a laṃ kā ra wa st+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas smad g.yogs bskon/ oṃ badzra rakṣa haṃ zhes pas stod g.yogs/ oṃ badzra uṣṇī ṣa hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas gtsug tor bya/ 'khyil pa bsngags pa'i gos dmar po'am ser po/ oṃ tsakṣurbandha wa ra ma ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭ kyis mig bcings/ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi 'phreng ba gtad/ las thams cad pa'i chus bsangs/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus snying mgrin dpral bar reg cing hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ brjod pas snying gar nyi ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ mgrin par nyi ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i padma dmar po āḥmatshan pa dang*/ spyi bor nyi ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de dag gi 'od zer gyis lus 'od shin tu dwangs shing gsal bar bsams la hūm̐ zhes brjod pas shar sgor bkod/ las kyi rdo rjes bzung dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir dri ba bya'o// kye khyod ci la dga'/ skal bzang bdag ni bde ba chen po la'o// de nas oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpata yā mi/ zhes lan gsum gyis byang chub tu sems bskyed du 'jug oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥ sid dhya badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar bzhag go /deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyis khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la mi smra zhing ma dad par yang mi bya'o// oṃ ya mānta kṛ ta hūm̐/

zhes pas 'khrid ā khaṃ bīr hūm̐ gis yol ba'i nang du gzhug oṃ ma hā ra ta su dṛ ḍhā su twa ṣya su su kho badzra sa twa ā dya sid dhya māṃ/ zhes brjod du bcug la g.yas skor byed cing thal mo sbyar nas shar sgor/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pasthā nā ya atmā nāṃ nīrya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra satwa a dhi tiṣṭha māṃ/ oṃ sarba bud dha pū dzo pasthā nā ya ātmā nāṃ nīrya ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badzra bai ro tsa na a dhi tiṣṭha māṃ/ lho sgo nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya ātmā nāṃ nīrya tayā mi/ sarba ta ga ta badzra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ nub sgo nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra wa nā ya ā tmā nāṃ nīrya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra dharma pra warta ya māṃ/ byang sgo nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇe ā tmā nāṃ nīrya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra karma ku ru ta māṃ/ zhes mi bskyod pa sogs sangs rgyas rnams la phyag byed du bcug nas shar gyi sgor/ oṃ gu ru tsa ra ṇo pa sthā nā ya ātmā nāṃ nīrya ta yā mi/ oṃ sarba sa twa pa ri dra ṇa rthaṃ ātmā nāṃ nīrya ta yā mi/ de nas rdo rje spyi bor bkod/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nang du zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar ma byed cig 'di smras na mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag /snying gar rdo rje bzung nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas/

rnam rgyal gyi steng gi dung chos kyi chu ming med dang*/ mthe bong sbyar bas sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u dka ṭha/ phan yon nyes pa gnyis ka'i sgo nas/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig /khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag par bya'o// de nas slob ma skad cig gis stong pa nyid kyi ngang las āḥlas snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig ces brjod du bcug de'i lte bar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa la nyi mar hūm̐ sngon po/ mgo bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ zla ba la yi ge haḥdakar po dang*/ mgrin par yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan g.yo ba gnyis kyis mtshan par zla ba la āḥyig dmar po/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes dang thugs gsung sku'i rdo rje rnam spyan drangs nas go rim bzhin du hūm̐ dang āḥl thim/ slob ma'i rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gis sbar ba'i raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor ram gyis mtshan pa steng du dzhaiḥde'i 'od zer rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pa dang*/ hūṃ dang āḥyi 'od zer gyis lus kun yongs su gang bar gyur/ spos bdug rol mor bcas/ ā be sha ya stambha ya ra ra ra ra tsā la ya tsa la ya hūṃ aḥdzhaiḥ

phebs nas/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod do// de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor bltar bcug la mig sngar ci snang dri/ kha dog gi dbye bas 'phrin las 'grub pa go bar bya/ rdo rje bzung rdo rje'i stang stabs kyis gar dang bcas pas 'khyil ba zlos shing*/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum byed du bcug slob dpon gyis bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa ni// bsod nams ji ltar de bzhin shog /'di yis dngos grub gang 'grub dang*// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di yi bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /'phreng ba chu dang cod pan dang*// rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang*// dam tshig slob dpon sngags gtad pa// mig sman me long mda' gzhu dang*// gsang ba shes rab bzhi pa dang*// rig ma rdo rje'i brtul zhugs te// lung bstan rjes gnang dbugs dbyung ba'o// traṃ yig gis mtshan zhing bsngags pa'i me tog gi 'phreng ba las gcig oṃ tiṣṭha badzra dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ shā shra to me bha ba/ hṛ da yamme a dhi tiṣṭha sarba sid dhimme pra yatstsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ pra tītstsha ku su māñdza li nāṃ tha hoḥ maṇḍal gyi tshom bu'am rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa la gnas pa la dor bar bya'o// gtsug tor la mchog /spyan nam zhal la sngags kyi/ yan lag la mchog dman bar ma la de ji lta ba'i thun mong gi nang tshan thag nye ba de ka lha gnyis kyi bar du 'phog na gang nye ba de'i rigs/ mnyam na gnyis kas byin gyis rlob// re khī nang tsam du phra mo// phyi rol tu lhung ngan skyor/ de nas 'phreng ba de lha dang bla mas de'i mgo bor/ oṃ pra ti gṛ hnatwa mi maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la zhes pas bcing ngo*// snying gar hūm̐/ dpral bar raṃ/ mig gnyis bar dang bcas par oṃ bsgoms la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/

oṃ dzñā na tsakṣu hūm̐ āḥ swā hā/ kye rdo rje ltos shig ces brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po nas brtsams te byang gi sgo skyong bsrung 'khor gyi gnod mdzes rgyal po'i bar ming brjod pas bstan nas/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ khyed rnams sangs rgyas rigs su skye// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlob// 'gro ba'i phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dngos grub kun gyi snod du 'gyur// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// zhes brjod/ de nas des/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so// rnal 'byor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong ngo*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes dam tshig brjod par bya// hoḥhoḥhoḥ chu dbang gi don du ji ltar 'byor ba'i yon phul nas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod sbyin ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// seng ge'i khri pad zla'i gdan la de nyid rdo rje 'dzin par mos pas dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas 'dug ste/ oṃ a bi ghnānta kṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pa'am 'khyil pa'i sngags/ yi ge hūm̐ lan bdun bzlas pa'i yungs kar/ g.yas g.yon gyi khu tshur gyis bzung nas slob ma la so sor lan gnyis g.yon du bskor nas/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya badzra satwa sya sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas sbyang ba bya zhing yungs kar mer dor/ de bzhin g.yas su bskor bas kyang bya/ de lta bu chus dang*/ kham phor dkar po/ ngur ba'i myu gu dang bcas pa'i lci ba'i chang bu zan changs seng ras rnams so sos kyang bya la/ kham phor sogs mer mi 'dor/ snying gar dri byugs/ me tog gi 'phreng ba mgo la bcing*/ mdun du mchod yon dbul/ mar mes yongs su bskor nas 'khyil pa dang yi ge hūm̐ bzlas pa'i mar dang bcas pa'i spos dkar la bdug par bya'o// de ltar sbyang ba byas nas/

slob dpon gyi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i phyogs na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang rig pa'i lha mo rnams yang dag par mchod/ slob ma la rigs lnga'i dbang bskur ba'i don du/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la dbang bskur stsol// zhes brjod nas/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gang bskur ba'i gtso bo yab yum du mos nas snying ga'i 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug zhal nas zhugs/ zhu bar gyur pa'i khu ba rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi padmar 'thon pa hūm̐ las rdo rje shes rab dang bcas pa'i mi bskyod pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa la/ slar snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ kha nas zhugs/ 'od du zhu ba'i rgyun gyis de dag la mngon par dbang bskur bas/ de mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i mā ma kī la 'khyud pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te padma nas phyir byung ba la/ nam mkha' gang bar gnas pa'i spyan ma la sogs pa rig ma rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa dang na bza' dang rol mo'i sgra dang glu dang gar dang me tog dang gur kum la sogs pa'i char rnams kyi bkod pa'i khyad par chen pos phyag gi byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dkar pos dbang bskur zhing gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /ma lus sems can skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// deng 'dir dbang bskur mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// zhes mchog gsum gyi shis pa bkra shis kyi glu rnams len bzhin par mos pas/

rnam par rgyal ba'i chu mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid can gyis dngos su/ dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ āḥbadzra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur khrus byas/ bde ba chen po phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro zhes bsam mo// byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ snying ga'i 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug zhal nas zhugs zhu bar gyur pa'i khu ba rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi padmar 'thon pa aṃ las rin po che shes rab dang bcas pa'i rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ye shes sems dpa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa la/ slar snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa spyan drangs kha nas zhugs 'od du zhu ba'i rgyun gyis de dag la mngon par dbang bskur bas/ rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po rin po che dang rin po che'i dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i rin chen rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te padma nas phyir byung ba la/ nam mkha' gang bar gnas pa'i spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa dang na bza' dang rol mo'i sgra dang glu dang gar dang me tog dang gur kum la sogs pa'i char rnams kyi bkod pa'i khyad par chen pos phyag gi rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin cod pan gyis dbang bskur zhing*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs bkra shis kyi glu rnams len bzhin pas/ oṃ badzra dhā twī shwa ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa twa badzrī a bhi ṣiñtsa bhrūm̐/ oṃ ratna badzrī a bhi ṣiñtsa aṃ/ oṃ dharm+ma badzrī a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karm+ma badzrī a bhi ṣiñtsa khaṃ/ mgo bor bzhag

dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje/ zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥbadzra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ su ra te st+waṃ/ a haṃ/ oṃ badzra tu ṣya hoḥ de'i rjes su/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥ zhes pas dar dpyangs sbyin/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ snying ga'i 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug zhal nas zhugs zhu bar gyur pa'i khu ba rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi padmar 'thon pa hrīḥ las padma shes rab dang bcas pa'i snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes kyi sems dpa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa la/ slar snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa spyan drangs kha nas zhugs 'od du zhu ba'i rgyun gyis de dag la mngon par dbang bskur bas snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po padma dang padma'i dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i gos dkar mo la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te padma nas phyir byung ba la/ nam mkha' gang bar gnas pa'i spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa dang na bza' dang rol mo'i sgra dang glu dang gar dang me tog dang gur kum la sogs pa'i char rnams kyi bkod pa'i khyad par chen pos phyag gi snang ba mtha' yas kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i dbang bskur zhing gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas bkra shis gang zhig sogs bkra shis kyi glu len bzhin pas/ dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che// rdo rje slob ma'i snying mgrin mgo bor reg cing lag par sbyin/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ sangs rgyas kun nas rab grub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyi long*// byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ snying ga'i 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug zhal nas zhugs zhu bar gyur pa'i khu ba rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi padmar 'thon pa khaṃ las ral gri shes rab dang bcas pa'i don yod grub pa'i sems dpa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa la/

slar snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa spyan drangs kha nas zhugs 'od du zhu ba'i rgyun gyis de dag la mngon par dbang bskur bas don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang ral gri'i dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i sgrol ma la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te padma nas phyir byung ba la/ nam mkha' gang bar gnas pa'i spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa dang na bza' dang rol mo'i sgra dang glu dang gar dang me tog dang gur kum la sogs pa'i char rnams kyi bkod pa'i khyad par chen pos phyag gi don grub kyi rang bzhin dril bus dbang bskur zhing*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas bkra shis gang zhig sogs bkra shis kyi glu rnams len bzhin pas dril bu lag pa g.yon par sbyin rdo rje dril bu dang ldan pa'i lag pas mngon par 'khyud pa'i tshul byed du bcug dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che// oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe āḥ āḥbacom ldan bdag gis gzungs lags kyi// bdag la nye bar gnas par mdzod// ces brjod/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab// snying ga'i 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug zhal nas zhugs zhu bar gyur pa'i khu ba rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi padmar 'thon pa oṃ las 'khor lo shes rab dang bcas pa'i rnam par snang mdzad kyi ye shes sems dpa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa la/ slar snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa spyan drangs kha nas zhugs 'od du zhu ba'i rgyun gyis de dag la mngon par dbang bskur bas rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i spyan ma la 'khyud pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te padma nas phyir byung ba la nam mkha' gang bar gnas pa'i spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa dang na bza' dang rol mo'i sgra dang glu dang gar me tog dang gur kum la sogs pa'i char rnams kyi bkod pa'i khyad par chen pos phyag gis mgo bor rdo rje dril bu gzung zhing rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin ming gi dbang bskur zhing gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas bkra shis gang zhig sogs bkra shis kyi glu rnams len bzhin pas/

dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che// sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ khyod zhe sdang rdo rje sogs me tog lhung ba'i rigs kyi ming gdags par bya'o// de ltar dbang drug po rnams kyis ma rig pa'i mi mthun phyogs su gnas pa rig pa nyid du sgrub par byed pas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya'o// dbang 'di rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i slob ma bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud gang yin pa dag nyan pa dang 'chad pa dang sngags sgrub pa la dbang byed par 'gyur ro// 'di dag slob dpon gyi dbang don du mi gnyer ba la thun mong gi sdom pa tsam byin la bskur/ gnyer na gnyis ka byin no// yon phul nas/ gang zhig bdag gis khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ rdo rje hūm̐ las byung ba rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor mos pas/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyam tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces brjod cing lag g.yas su gtad pas rdo rje'i de nyid gzung de nas dril bu āḥlas byung ba/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// ces brjod nas g.yon du gtad// dril bu'i de kho na nyid gzung*/ slob mas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur// zhes brjod nas dkrol/ yid kyi lus ni brtan byed pa// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// 'dod pa kun la longs spyod pas// dngos grub dam pa sbyin par bya// rdo rje sems dpa'i sku ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang yang dag par sbyor ba'i rim pas byin gyis brlabs pa 'khyud pa'i tshul du bya'o// de nas slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rdo rje snyems ma dmar po gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa la nam mkha' gang bar gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa dang*/

na bza' dang rol mo'i sgra dang glu dang gar dang me tog dang gur kum la sogs pa'i char rnams kyi bkod pa'i khyad par chen pos phyag gi byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dkar pos dbang bskur zhing gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// sogs bkra shis kyi glu rnams len bzhin pas/ dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur// khrus byas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan dang*/ gzhan de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang lha mo rnams ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du de nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swā hā/ me tog sogs kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin gzhal yas khang ngo*// zhes pas dkyil 'khor dang*/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lnga ru rab tu grags// rdo rje skye mched nyid dag ni// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /ces dang*// yan lag dag gi khro bo bcu// zhes pas lha'i dag pa/ don dam par ni/ sna tshogs de bzhin nyid bdag med/ thabs ni snying rje'i stobs yin te// zung du 'jug pa rnam rtog bral// dkyil 'khor snying po mchog yin no// zhes de bzhin nyid kyi rnam dag bshad par spro na man ngag snye ma bzhin bstan no// de nas slob dpon gyi las bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang*// stang stabs 'dug stangs bzlas brjod dang*// sbyin sreg mchod pa las sbyor dang*// slar sdud pa yi rnam pa ni// phyi yi de nyid bcu yin no// zhes dang*/ phyir bzlog /gnyis kyi cho ga dang*// gsang dang shes rab ye shes dang*// kha sbyar 'byed pa'i cho ga dang*// gtor ma rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*// drag shul bsgrub pa'i cho ga dang*// rab tu gnas dang dkyil 'khor bsgrub// gsang ba'i de nyid bcu yin no// zhes dang*/

'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyed kyi nam yang ma byed cig /rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig rnams bskyang bar bya'o// zhes ston no// de dag ni phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang ngam// ming gzhan rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i sngags lan gsum bzlas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// slob mas kyang*/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes pas sngags gtad do// gser dngul gyi snod du sbrang rtsi'i mig sman gser gyi thur mas blangs slob ma'i mig la praṃ bsams nas/ oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// de nas me long la a brjod pa slob mar bstan te/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin// gsal cing dag la rnyog pa med// bu khyod kyi ni snying la gnas// sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin no// ngo bo med cing gnas pa med// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye// de nas hoḥyig las byung ba'i mda' gzhu hoḥ brjod pas sbyin/ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya swa/ zhes brjod nas mda' 'phang pa'i tshul gyis sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga yā mi/ zhes brjod nas bgegs la 'bigs pa'i blos phyogs bzhi steng dang 'og tu 'phang bar bya'o// bum dbang mthar brten dang bcas pa'o// bla ma la gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul nas/ rdo rje sems dpar mos pas thal mo sbyar te/

khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// bdag gis bla med bya ba thob// de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// mgon po rjes su gzung bar mdzod// lan gsum brjod/ mig dar bcings/ bla ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gang yin pa de'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyag rgya stong pa nyid las rigs kyi yum du bskyed pa dang rdo rje padma 'dus byas pa sngon du 'gro bas snyoms par zhugs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ kha nas zhugs 'od du zhu bar gyur pa a ba dhū tī nas brgyud rdo rje nor bur lhan cig skyes pa brtan par byas pa rang gi byang chub sems dang gnyis su med pa ste gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// rdo rje 'dzin sogs dbang bskur ltar// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra dhṛka hūm̐/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ slob mas rdo rje dang shes rab kyi chu skyes nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun 'dus pa'i blos btung bar bya'o// thabs dang shes rab dag gi kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dag gis gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas gsang dbang zhes bya'o// sher dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab// phyag rgya dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyi// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags// 'khor lo'i rim par sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis// rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni// nor bu'i nang du tshud par blta// zhes go bar byas nas gtad// des kyang skye gnas gur kum la sogs pa'i chus dri zhim par byas gos dang bral ba lag pas bgrad de slob ma la ston cing*/ e ma bdag gi padma 'di// bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas// gang zhig cho ga bzhin brten na// bdag ni de yi mdun na gnas// bde ba'i cho ga la ni sogs pa ni// ji ltar bya ba padmar gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid la ni rtag tu gnas/

bhāñdza mokṣa hoḥ de nas slob ma rang dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dang shes rab lha mor bskyed nas a las padma ze'u 'bru as mtshan pa dang*/ hūm̐ las rdo rje nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭ ser pos bkag pa bha ga'i g.yon pa'i rtsa rtser hrīḥdamar po/ 'dzub mo'am lces/ oṃ shī shī hī ha ha ha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing snyoms par 'jug dus bla mas bstan pa 'di dga' ba'i dbye ba rig pas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas rang gi lus la bcug par bsam zhing bla mas kyang dmigs par bya'o// dga' ba brtsams pa'i mthar shes rab dang sbyor dpal gyis ni// de nyid yang dag mtshon par bya// rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni// nor bu'i nang du tshud par blta// ji ltar nus pa btung de dal bus phyung nas chu skyes las lces blangs te de kho na nyid kyi lta bas dam tshig gi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems btung bar bya'o// de nas tshig kho nas dbang bzhi pa ster te/ de nyid ni shes rab ye shes kyis myu gur gyur pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas 'phel ba dang 'grib pa med pa dang ldan pa'i de kho na nyid chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin te yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bor brjod par bya'o// zhes pas so// de nas g.yon pas shes rab kyi lag pa slob ma'i lag par gtad/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa spyi bor bzhag nas/ 'dir ni khyed rnams dpang po yin// bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dpang por byas nas/ thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min// 'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa yin// de phyir 'di dang bral bar ni// khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med// rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// rig ma'i brtul zhugs so// de nas slob ma rdo rje sems dpar mos pas/

'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs bstan// khyed kyis kyang ni rtag tu gzung*// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid dhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa ya st+waṃ dha ra yā mi badzra sa twa hī/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas gzung*/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so// de nas spyod pa'i brtul zhugs la gsum// bde thod dgyes gsum gang yang rung ba'i sngags lan gsum bzlas pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga ḍā ma ru dpa' bo'i snod gsum/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// des na khaṭwāṃ cang te'u snod// sbyin pa dpa' bos gzung bar gyis// zhes pas/ nang gi phyag rgya gsum la sbyor ba lhur len pa'i phyir te/ kha ṭwāṃ ga ni lha yi sku// shes rab ḍā ma ru ru brtag /ces dang*/ sngags ni btung ba thod pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa bud med dam skyes pa spyod pa'i brtul zhugs la zhugs pa na/ bdag med ma phag mo'am me tog lhung ba'i rigs kyi lha mo dang*/ skyes pa bde dgyes la sogs pa'i he ru kar bsams nas/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa lta bu'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur pa las/ phyag rgya lnga sangs rgyas lngar bsgom/ so so'i snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa lta bu'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par byas nas/ oṃ dha ra dha ra dhā ra ya ma rdha ma rdha badzra dhṛ ga phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i 'khor lo// mi bskyod pa yi phyag rgya nyid// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// 'khor lo mi bskyod pa yi gzugs// sbyin pa dpa' bos blang bar gyis// bud med yin na// lha mos blang bar gyis// spyi bor/ oṃ badzra dharma sa ma ya st+waṃ hu lu hu lu a ro l̥g phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i rna rgyan/ 'od dpag med pa'i phyag rgya ni// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// rna rgyan 'od dpag med pa nyid// sbyin pa dpa' bos blang bar gyis// rna bar/

oṃ badzra sūrya ta mo bid ma hā sa ma ya st+waṃ haṃ ratna dhā+-i ga phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i mgul rgyan/ rin chen 'byung ldan phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// mgul rgyan rin chen 'byung ldan nyid// sbyin pa dpa' bor blang bar gyis// mgul/ oṃ sha shwa taṃ pa raṃ te sha shwa ta e hye hi dzin dzṛg phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i lag gdub/ rnam par snang mdzad phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// lag gdub rtag pa'i bdag nyid can// sbyin pa dpa' bos blang bar gyis// lag par/ oṃ phuḥphuḥhi hi hi pra dzñā dhṛg phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i ska rags/ don yod grub pa'i phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// don yon grub pa ska rags nyid// sbyin pa dpa' bos blang bar gyis// sked par ro// shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes lnga skye ba la sbyor ba lhur len pa'i phyir te/ 'khor lo'i gzugs kyis mi bskyod pa// rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med// mgul gyi 'phreng ba rin chen dbang*// lag gdub rnam par snang mdzad brjod// ska rags la ni don grub gnas// zhes so// gsum pa/ skyes pa'am bud med gang nus pa thob nas gzhan du yang rung spyod pa'i brtul zhugs len par 'dod na// de la bde mchog gam phag mor bltas nas de'i snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bsgom pa lta bu'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur pa la phyag rgya lnga sangs rgyas lngar dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba sogs rang rang gi sngags kyi lha nyid du mos pas/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i 'khor lo sngags de nyid kyis thod pa lnga bskon/ thod pa de nyid 'khor lo'i gzugs su yang bshad do// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i rna rgyan btags/ oṃ sarba bud dha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

lan gsum bzlas pa'i mgul rgyan/ auoṃ haḥ na maḥhi/ swa ha hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥ phaṭ haṃ/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i gdu bu/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yauṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭ phaṭ/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i ska rags/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭ ḍā ki nī dzā la samba raṃ swā hā/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i mgo rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi 'phreng ba/ oṃ sarba bud dha ḍā ki zhes phag mo'i rtsa sngags kyis stag sham/ oṃ pra tsaṇḍe huṃ hūṃ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sum cu rtsa drug gi sngags lan gsum bzlas pa'i thod pa lag par/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ḍā ma ru bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i sngags/ de bzhin des tshangs skud mgrin par dang*/ do shal dang rdo rje'i rgyan rkun po'i skra'i cod pan skor gnyis pa'i ska rags thal ba dpung rgyan rkang gdub se ral kha rnams rang rang gi gnas su'o// 'dir ni stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin byang chub sems kyi 'byung ba la sbyor te/ 'bad de nus pa bskyed par bya// nus pa bskyed pa'i rjes la ni// brtul zhugs spyod pa yid 'ong ba// rigs lnga mnyam par kun spyod pa// rigs gcig tu ni yang dag brtag /ces sogs kyis so// phyi ma 'di gnyis ni nus pa brnyed nas dmigs bsal du gsungs kyis gzhan du snga ma tsam bya'o// de nas slob dpon de bzhin gshegs pa lung ston pa'i tshul ltar mdzad pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// 'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan yin// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// kye che ge mo sarba ta thā ga ta sid dhya sa ma ya st+waṃ bhurbu baḥswaḥ gsang mtshan gyis so// gang yang de ltar lung bstan pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan no// zhes dad par bya'o// de nas/ byang chub sems kyi dbang gis ni// slob ma sdig dang bral ba la// de nas rjes su gnang ba sbyin/

zhes pas/ slob ma'i gdan gyi mdun du bhruṃ las byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bzhag oṃ badzra he tu māṃ/ oṃ badzra bha ṣa raṃ/ lag pa g.yas su a las skyes pa'i dung dang*/ g.yon du a las skyes pa'i pu sta ka byin/ āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu dkrol du bcug la/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dag dang mnyam sbyor bas// kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal// deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// slob ma rnam snang sogs rigs lngar rim pa bzhin gsal btab ste /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong nas// skyon med dogs dang bral ba yis// de ltar sems can don gyis shig /chos kyi 'khor lo'i tshab tu/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ padma/ las kyi tshig bcug rim pa bzhin rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gtad/ de nas phyag btsal/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ ces khas blang ngo*// de nas spyi bor gdugs bzung dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byed du bcug sgor thal mo sbyar/ rgyud ni 'dzin par 'gyur ba yi// slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags// dkyil 'khor bdag por slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab// gdugs gzhan du bzhag nas/ de ni khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi// slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kyang ni bzhed pa yin// sems can kun la brtse don du// dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris// khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su// sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor// mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// mthong ba dang ni zhugs pa yis// sdig pa kun las nges par grol// khyed rnams 'di ni the tshom med// de ring khyed rnams legs par gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// slar khyod mchi ba yod ma yin// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis// de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur ro// khams gsum pa yi rgyal srid che// bdag po nyid du khyod nges so// 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig
